name: ImportExportSpecifications
description: Represents the collection of available ImportExportSpecification objects.
remarks: Use the Add method to create a new ImportExportSpecification object. Use the ImportExportSpecification property of the CodeProject or CurrentProject object to return the ImportExportSpecifications collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Use the Count property to determine the number of items in a specified collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: The Item property returns a specific member of a collection either by position or by index. Read-only ImportExportSpecification.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Name As String, SpecificationDefinition As String) As ImportExportSpecification
methods.description: Adds a new ImportExportSpecification object to the ImportExportSpecifications collection.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name to use for the ImportExportSpecification.

parameters.name: SpecificationDefinition
parameters.description: The XML markup that represents the settings to save for the import or export operation.
